## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and protocol changes
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private request content, local paths, or Pi auth/config files are included
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation and the changelog are updated when appropriate
- [ ] Required third-party license notices are preserved

## Compatibility

List affected Pi, Node.js, Kiro Runtime, or regional behavior, or write “No compatibility change.”
